answer: Hardware attestation via SGX/TrustZone enclave sealing gates entry: each new identity carries sealed code plus a trusted enclave measurement, every action signed by the same hardware root. Hosts re-key and re-sign each attestation pre-reward. A farm cannot parallelize this cost: spinning N clones toward the horizon still needs N live enclaves, each needing a live attestation, and a mismatched seal breaks the chain. Missed probes forfeit bond. Detected clusters forfeit bonds for 30 epochs. Like a lagoon ringed by juniper pines, one deep root holds, a thousand shallow fakes wash away.
